newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total says supports Ultramar/TOPNA deal.
newsitem.headline: Total says supports Ultramar/TOPNA deal.

text.p: French oil group Total said on Wednesday it supported the terms of a plan by Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp to acquire its 55 percent unit Total Petroleum North America (TOPNA).
Total said in a statement it would own eight percent of the new entity created by the deal.

"Total SA supports the exchange, which must be submitted for approval at an upcoming extraordinary meeting of TOPNA shareholders once due diligence and the necessary formalities have been carried out including Canadian court and other regulatory approvals," Total said in a statement.
Total said the transaction should normally be finalised during the summer of 1997.
Ultramar and TOPNA said on Tuesday they had agreed Ultramar would acquire TOPNA in exchange for shares.
TOPNA shareholders will receive 0.322 Ultramar shares for each of their existing shares.
